description: Submit a new business for human review. Same validation and rate limits as POST /api/submit. Accepts open_to_cofounder, cofounder_note, and optional heard_from (stored as mcp when omitted). heard_from is stored for admin review only. Requires founder consent. A website host that is already listed or under review is rejected; the error includes slug only when that listing is approved. Only submit businesses that meet the listing criteria: An online business you run: a product, SaaS, app or service people can use or buy today, built to last. One-trick trend generators (one photo into this week's viral clip) are not listed; A real website with substance: what it does, who is behind it and how to reach you. No placeholder or "coming soon" pages; One listing per business. Several tools from the same maker are one listing, not one per subdomain; Its own product, not a borrowed name: building on someone else's AI model is fine, but a site named after the model (Sora, Nano Banana, Seedance…) is not listed; Plays by the rules of the platforms it builds on: nothing that breaks the terms of X, Google, Reddit or others (scraping, reply bots, fake engagement); Submitted to be found, not for a backlink: no SEO-only content sites, other directories, link-building services or mass directory submissions; No MLM, get-rich-quick schemes, trading bots or signals, gambling, or adult content; Accurate city and country for where the founder is based.

cofounder_note.description: Short note for cofounder search (if open)

heard_from.description: Optional. How the founder heard about Founderhood. If omitted, stored as "mcp". Preferred values: x, directory_list:<short text> (bare directory_list is still accepted), google, ai_assistant, friend, reddit, newsletter, or other:<short text>. Admin-only; never returned by search_founders or get_founder.

open_to_cofounder.description: Mark founder as open to finding a cofounder
